label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee/community feast and private presentation for the mayor, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall, aiming for 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns. Innkeeper, builder and freight coordinated funding, baking, deliveries and escort. Baker knowingly provided oven access and later supplies and bread; secretary arranged attendance and escort while presentation details remained private; neighbour helped deliver bread but is not shown knowing the jubilee/surprise purpose. Mayor knew of the gathering, refreshments and private presentation and guessed it might concern forty years of service; the secret was its jubilee purpose/details, not the existence of the event.
